as_told.title: Karl Nell on a secret decades-long arms race

plain: Karl Nell is a retired US Army colonel who, according to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, helped set up Army Futures Command, a part of the Army focused on new technology. Michels says that Nell, speaking to an online news outlet called The Debrief, said the United States is in an arms race with Russia and China to reverse engineer, meaning take apart and copy, crashed craft of unknown origin. Michels suggests taking those words at face value. An online researcher known as UAPGerb repeats Nell's point without the arms race. He says Nell states that the US actively has such craft and is working out how to use their systems. If true, it would mean world powers are quietly racing to master non-human technology.
